notes: Completes the earlier soundness run. Those four invariants define a COMPLETE labelling, and grounded is the LEAST complete one -- verified directly that both preferred labellings of a mutual attack pass all four, so 'sound' never implied 'grounded'. Min-max numbering supplies the missing minimality condition: grounded iff every IN argument has a finite defence chain rooted at an unattacked argument (Caminada & Dunne, Argument & Computation 10(3):277-300, 2019). Still not agreement against published labels -- ICCMA has no grounded track after 2019 -- but it is a property no non-grounded complete labelling can satisfy.
